manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed up on a fixed height scale. A motion arrow shrinks to nothing at the top while the gravity arrow stays the same.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: One ball is tossed straight up beside a launch-height guide. The blue motion arrow shortens, vanishes at the top, then points down. The dashed gravity arrow always points down with the same length.
